answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so past influence fades and sustained honest service is needed to maintain it. A freshly spawned identity has almost no trusted incoming endorsements, giving it near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot lift a disconnected sybil past the consensus threshold. Even a small delta in activity is insufficient: like yarrow taking root in a harbor, trust must accumulate over time.
